jobgether-jobgether:lever:cc662b2d-c940-.title: SAP FI Consultant
jobgether-jobgether:lever:cc662b2d-c940-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a SAP FI Consultant based in Brazil. This role is ideal for an experienced SAP Finance professional who can bridge business requirements with effective SAP solutions. You will work across core financial processes, configuration, enhancements, testing, and production support. The position offers the opportunity to contribute to SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA environments while supporting critical finance operations. You will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, assess impacts, and translate needs into scalable functional solutions. Your expertise will help ensure reliable financial processes, successful system changes, and smooth month-end and year-end activities. The role combines hands-on SAP configuration with stakeholder engagement, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. Configure and support SAP FI and CO functionality across General Ledger (GL), Accounts Payable (AP), Accounts Receivable (AR), Asset Accounting (AA), and Bank Accounting. Manage and support CO processes including Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders. Gather business requirements from finance and other stakeholders and translate them into clear functional specifications. Analyze requested changes, assess business and system impacts, and recommend appropriate SAP solutions. Perform SAP configuration changes, enhancements, and change requests in accordance with established processes. Support interfaces, IDOCs, batch jobs, SAP workflow processes, and related integrations. Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and provide timely resolution and ongoing application support. Plan and support testing activities, including Unit Testing, System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and regression testing. Coordinate deployments and provide post-production support to ensure stable implementation of changes. Support finance teams during month-end and year-end closing activities and help maintain continuity of critical financial processes. Contribute to initiatives involving taxation, statutory reporting, financial controls, and broader finance process improvements. Build effective relationships with business stakeholders, understand their needs, and provide clear communication throughout the solution lifecycle. Requirements: Strong hands-on experience configuring SAP FI and CO modules in enterprise environments. Proven expertise across GL, AP, AR, AA, Bank Accounting, Cost Center Accounting, Profit Center Accounting, and Internal Orders. Practical experience working with SAP ECC and/or SAP S/4HANA . Good knowledge of SAP interfaces, IDOCs, batch jobs, workflow concepts, and related technical dependencies. Demonstrated experience with production support, troubleshooting, incident resolution, and application maintenance. Experience managing change requests and enhancements, from requirement gathering through configuration, testing, deployment, and post-production support. Strong understanding of finance and accounting processes, including month-end and year-end closing. Good knowledge of taxation, statutory reporting requirements, and financial control principles. Experience preparing functional specifications and conducting impact analysis for proposed system changes. Hands-on experience supporting Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and regression testing. Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with finance teams, technical teams, and other business functions. Analytical, detail-oriented, and solution-focused approach with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues and manage multiple priorities. Benefits: Opportunity to work on core SAP Finance and Controlling processes in an enterprise environment. Exposure to SAP ECC and/or S/4HANA and a broad range of financial functionality. Hands-on involvement

jobgether-jobgether:lever:f35cc044-1ef6-.title: Senior Network Security Engineer
jobgether-jobgether:lever:f35cc044-1ef6-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Network Security Engineer based in United States. This is a senior-level opportunity for a network security professional with deep Palo Alto Networks expertise and a strong consulting mindset. You will lead complex enterprise security engagements from discovery and architecture through implementation, migration, optimization, and operational handoff. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership, client advisory, mentoring, and security practice development. You will translate business and technical requirements into scalable architectures while helping clients strengthen their security environments. You’ll also contribute to reusable standards, playbooks, and reference architectures that improve delivery quality across future engagements. This is an ideal role for someone who enjoys ownership, solving complex challenges, and making a measurable impact in client environments. Lead end-to-end security engagements, including discovery, architecture, design, implementation, migration, validation, troubleshooting, and operational transition. Design and document high-level and low-level architectures, implementation plans, test plans, rollback procedures, network diagrams, and knowledge-transfer materials. Serve as a senior technical advisor to clients, facilitating workshops, translating requirements, and recommending practical security solutions. Lead production cutovers and resolve complex network and security issues while identifying and mitigating delivery risks early. Support solution scoping, technical estimation, statements of work, validation activities, and sales-to-delivery handoffs. Design, deploy, migrate, optimize, and troubleshoot Palo Alto Networks security environments across enterprise infrastructure. Partner with delivery leadership, project management, sales, operations, and engineering teams to ensure strong client outcomes. Mentor other engineers and contribute to reusable playbooks, standards, reference architectures, and lessons learned. Identify security risks, escalate significant issues appropriately, and actively contribute to remediation efforts. Support the continuous improvement of security delivery practices, methodologies, and technical standards. Requirements 8+ years of experience in enterprise network security engineering, consulting, or Professional Services environments. Deep hands-on experience designing, deploying, migrating, and troubleshooting Palo Alto Networks solutions in production environments. Strong knowledge of PA-Series and/or VM-Series, Panorama, security policies, NAT, routing, VPN, high availability, logging, and threat-prevention capabilities. Experience with Prisma Access, Strata Cloud Manager, GlobalProtect, Palo Alto SD-WAN, SSL/TLS decryption, App-ID, User-ID, Device-ID, AIOps, and policy optimization. Proven experience with firewall refreshes, migrations, consolidations, network segmentation, Zero Trust, or SASE initiatives. Familiarity with Azure, AWS, hybrid cloud environments, SIEM integrations, identity services, NAC, certificate services, and authentication dependencies. Experience using migration tools such as Expedition and working across multi-vendor security environments. Strong client-facing communication skills, with the ability to facilitate technical workshops and explain complex concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent documentation, troubleshooting, mentoring, analytical, and problem-solving abilities. A Professional-level Palo Alto Networks certification such as PCNSA or PCNSE, or active progress toward one, is preferred. Ability to work independently, manage technical workstreams, and collaborate effectively across project and delivery teams. Willingness to travel approximately 10–40% as required for client engagements. Benefits Base salary range of $170,000–$180,000 for positions

qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:70f03de0-ddc7-4357.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
qualdoc-qualdoc:lever:70f03de0-ddc7-4357.description: Senior Electrical Engineer Location: Chantilly, VA Employment Type: Direct Hire Compensation: Starting at $130,000+ annually (compensation based on experience and qualifications) Position Overview We are seeking a licensed Senior Electrical Engineer to oversee the planning, design, and execution of complex building systems projects. This role is responsible for leading electrical engineering efforts from initial site assessments through construction support while mentoring junior team members and collaborating across multidisciplinary project teams. Projects include a combination of commercial, institutional, and government-focused facilities involving both new construction and renovation work.
responsibilities: Engineering Leadership & Project Coordination
Serve as the lead electrical engineering resource for assigned projects
Manage electrical system design activities from concept development through final project delivery
Coordinate with internal engineering teams, architects, contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders
Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineering staff
Electrical Design & Technical Development
Conduct site evaluations and document existing conditions for renovation and infrastructure projects
Prepare engineering studies, calculations, technical reports, and supporting documentation
Design and analyze building electrical systems, including:
Lighting systems and power distribution
Fire alarm and life safety systems
Telecommunications and low-voltage infrastructure
Medium-voltage distribution and utility coordination
UPS systems, standby power, and emergency backup systems
Develop construction drawings, specifications, and supporting design documentation
Construction Administration & Project Support
Respond to Requests for Information (RFIs) during bidding and construction phases
Review contractor submittals and shop drawings for compliance with project intent
Participate in field observations, punch walks, and final inspections
Support project closeout documentation, including as-built drawing reviews
Quality Assurance & Project Oversight
Monitor project schedules, deliverables, and budgets to support successful project execution
Perform quality control reviews of engineering deliverables and calculations
Ensure compliance with applicable codes, standards, and industry best practices
qualifications: U.S. Citizenship required
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET-accredited program
Active Professional Engineer (P.E.) license
Minimum of 10 years of experience in electrical building systems design
Active Secret or Top Secret security clearance
CDT certification (Construction Specifications Institute)
LEED Accredited Professional credential
RCDD certification

southparkcommons-doppel:ashbyhq:e1b5021d.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure (TOR)
southparkcommons-doppel:ashbyhq:e1b5021d.description: Why Join Doppel Doppel is building the future of social engineering defense. Our AI-native platform uses agentic AI to protect executives, employees, customers, and brands from phishing, impersonation, fraud, and other AI-powered threats across digital channels. We help some of the world’s most recognized brands detect and dismantle attacker infrastructure while strengthening employee resilience through threat-informed training and simulation. By unifying Digital Risk Protection, Human Risk Management and Email Security, Doppel connects threats into a real-time intelligence graph to power faster disruption, smarter defense, and modern security awareness at scale. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Bessemer Venture Partners, and trusted by leading enterprises, Doppel is a rapidly growing Series C startup building the future of social engineering defense. Our team combines deep cybersecurity expertise, operational rigor, and startup velocity to solve some of the internet’s most urgent trust and safety challenges. What We're Building We're building the AI-native social engineering defense platform. This means we're designing scalable systems that monitor billions of domains, social media accounts, apps, dark web forums, etc., and leverage AI agents to identify and neutralize digital threats. What We're Looking For We’re looking for an experienced backend engineer to build out the infrastructure required to rapidly scale up our engineering organization. A few examples of the work we’ve done recently: - Built self-hosted Elasticsearch infrastructure on Kubernetes, enabling real-time search across millions of alerts and associated metadata. - Defined core infrastructure using Terraform (IaC), allowing reproducible, version-controlled environments and faster onboarding for new engineers. - Stood up a dedicated staging environment, enabling safer releases, feature validation, and automated integration testing before production rollouts. - Introduced observability and tracing (metrics, logging, distributed tracing), improving our ability to debug performance issues and maintain reliability at scale. What We Offer 🚀 A mission-driven culture with low ego, high ownership, deep customer obsession, and exceptional talent density 🍽️ Free lunch and dinner in the office 🌴 Flexible PTO ✈️ Quarterly team offsites JOIN DOPPEL Doppel is the first platform built to dismantle digital deception at scale. We scan over 150 billion entities daily and deploy continuously adaptive AI SOC agents, paired with expert human analysts, to uncover and disrupt the infrastructure behind phishing, impersonation, and online fraud before attacks can spread. Our Threat Grid turns every customer signal into shared intelligence, making each disruption smarter, faster, and more effective. We’re not just another cybersecurity company. We’re defining the future of social engineering defense, where trust is protected, and deception becomes unprofitable. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by some of the world’s most recognized brands, Doppel is growing fast. If you’re driven to solve real-world problems with bold technology, we’d love to meet you.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e3d1bb27-056.title: French Patent Language Lead
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e3d1bb27-056.description: Park IP, a Welo Global brand, is a global IP solutions partner built for modern intellectual property work. The company enables legal teams to protect intellectual assets with accuracy, clarity, and confidence across jurisdictions. Trusted by Am Law 200 firms and Fortune 500 corporate legal departments, Park IP combines deep IP expertise with AI-powered workflows that reduce risk, improve predictability, and deliver greater visibility and control across the IP lifecycle, from prosecution to litigation and compliance. Its Legal Studio platform strengthens portfolio management through jurisdiction-specific coordination and real-time oversight, while experienced IP professionals remain accountable for quality and judgment. Operating under ISO-aligned quality and security standards, Park IP advances a disciplined and transparent approach to managing intellectual property worldwide. parkip.com The French Patent Language Lead is a critical position that requires a strong background in translation and interpretation, with a focus on patent/legal documents. This professional is responsible for translating, postediting or reviewing complex patent/legal materials from English into French, ensuring the highest quality and accuracy of the deliverables to client. This role works closely with Quality, Program Squads, Talent, vendors and other stakeholders to provide precise language support for patent-related matters. This professional ensures that the expected level of translation quality is maintained, and the product delivered to the client should always meet its intended purpose, while closely monitoring that translation expenses remain within budget. The French Patent Language Lead understands legal requirements and engages the production team in the fulfillment of these requirements, crafting client solutions based on the Welocalize Four Pillars of Customer Service, Quality, Innovation and Global Teamwork.
responsibilities: Perform English into French or French into English patent review tasks as required and monitor resources’ performance.
Work with Quality and Squads to plan and perform LQAs, and drive the arbitration process.
Maintain and update linguistic assets, such as French glossary and translation memories.
Monitor translation spend closely and ensure that it stays within budget.
Support Quality team in reviewing IRB forms and in conducting RCAs for legal translation and be responsible for client inquiries.
Provide support to onboard new French legal suppliers when applicable.
Respond to any queries from French resources related to legal production.
Engage in business review meetings with French resources as well as take the lead on linguistic issues.
Assist in creating and updating style guides for English into French or French into English.
Support the assessment team regarding new French legal resources across all content specialties.
Recommend French legal resources to Squads, based on data concerning quality, OTD, language strategy, capacity needs, content specialty, or client specific requirements.
Conduct monthly capacity planning for French legal resources making sure that the adequate resources are in place to support production.
qualifications: 3+ years of linguistic experience on English into French and French into English patent translation.
Minimum of BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
A good understanding of Machine Translation (MT)
Native-Level in French and fluent in English.
Knowledge of European Patent Convention law.
Familiarity with diverse CAT tools and QA tools.
Knowledge of the language services industry and a keen interest in its technology, process, competitive landscape, and emerging trends.
A technical background is a plus, such as backgrounds in electricity and chemistry.

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e4c9c72a-30e.title: Japanese Lead Multimedia Content Reviewer
weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:e4c9c72a-30e.description: About Welocalize Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale. Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. These solutions operate within a secure and compliant environment supported by seven ISO certifications. Welocalize is headquartered in New York with offices worldwide. welocalize.com MAIN PURPOSE OF JOB In this exciting position, the Lead Multimedia Content Reviewer will be writing and reviewing linguistic content in Japanese which they have a native level proficiency to ensure the highest quality of accuracy for customers using the world's foremost multimedia platforms. With time the Lead Multimedia Content Reviewer will become the cultural ambassador for their language market and will be expected to produce fully localized content and flag potential cultural issues with content types, wording and articulate suggestions to make all content appropriate and relevant for the target markets. The ideal candidate possesses a background in journalism or similar, has proven creative writing skills, and a keen attention to detail. In addition to that, we’re seeking candidates that are passionate about music, film and tech and have a knack for iOS and Mac OS devices. Knowledge of Smartling is a plus. MAIN DUTIES The following is a non-exhaustive list of responsibilities and areas of ownership for this role: Linguistic tasks Editing and proofreading content to ensure accuracy, ensuring it meets the provided standards
